title: Repair Agents with Tool Use
abstract: An agent that fixes failing tests by calling a compiler, a test runner and a code search tool outperforms a single-shot model.

sections.title: 1 Introduction
sections.text: Automated program repair has moved from templates to language models that call tools.

sections.title: 2 Agent loop
sections.text: The agent reads the failing test, searches the repository, proposes a patch and runs the tests again until they pass or a budget ends.
